6a1(khri brgyad): @#//bya'o/zhes zer na/ci de 'phags pa khyod kyi byin gyi rlabs yin nam/de khyod kyi mthu yin/rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ko'u shi ka 
6a2(khri brgyad): de ni kho bo'i mthu ma yin no//de ni kho bo'i byin gyi rlabs ma yin no//brgya byin gyis smras pa/btsun ba rab 'byor 'o na de su'i mthu yin/de su'i byin gyi rlabs yin/
6a3(khri brgyad): rabyor gyis smras pa/ko'u shika 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu yin no//'di ni de bzhin gshegs ba'i byin gyis rlabs yin no//brgya byin gyis smas pa/btsun 
6a4(khri brgyad): ba rab 'byor chos thams cad ni byin gyis brlabs med pa yin no//ci'i phyir 'di skad du 'di ni de bzhin gshegs gas pa'i mthu yin no/'di ni de bzhin gsheg+sa
